customer_name: Shandong Port Group (山东省港口集团有限公司)
business_problem: Shandong Port Group needed a better way to serve many kinds of logistics customers because information was fragmented, multimodal transport coordination was weak, and inconsistent service processes limited logistics efficiency and hurt the port business environment.
solution_summary: Shandong Port Group used large-model technology to build six intelligent-agent applications for outward-facing supply-chain services: Shipowner Steward, Smart Route Pilot, Port Encyclopedia, Intelligent Tracking, Intelligent Customs Clearance, and Smart Price Inquiry. Instead of focusing only on back-office AI, the project targeted the operational pain points of ship owners, freight forwarders, cargo owners, customs stakeholders, and truck drivers. Each agent applies the pretrained model's language understanding, generation, reasoning, or BI analysis abilities to a different workflow: ship and KPI queries, navigation and yard guidance, policy and process Q&A, real-time container visibility, HS code matching and customs-process explanation, and route-and-cost planning. Together, the agents create a common intelligent service layer across the port group's fragmented workflows, helping logistics users get more consistent answers and faster execution while giving the port a reusable smart-supply-chain interface for ongoing expansion.

solution_components.name: Shipowner Steward
solution_components.role: Provides ship companies and agents with vessel-dynamics and KPI inquiry services.

solution_components.name: Smart Route Pilot
solution_components.role: Guides truck drivers through port operations and reduces waiting time during port work.

solution_components.name: Port Encyclopedia
solution_components.role: Answers questions about policies, regulations, business processes, and industry notices by integrating port, customs, and maritime information.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Tracking
solution_components.role: Gives customers real-time visibility into container status and cargo movement through the port.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Customs Clearance
solution_components.role: Matches HS codes and explains import-export customs-clearance processes for cargo owners and forwarders.

solution_components.name: Smart Price Inquiry
solution_components.role: Uses model reasoning to plan transport routes and estimate cost options for logistics customers.

data_flow: Port, customs, maritime, logistics, and shipment-status data feed the six supply-chain agents, each agent applies large-model reasoning to a specific customer workflow, and the results return as guidance, tracking, policy answers, or route recommendations to external users across the port ecosystem.
business_outcome: Shandong Port Group created a smarter customer-facing supply-chain service layer that can reduce friction across port logistics, improve transparency, and support long-term smart-port transformation.
architecture_clues: The deployment is organized as six separate agent applications rather than one monolithic assistant.
The system combines language understanding, generation, reasoning, and BI analysis across multiple customer groups.
The port solution focuses on external supply-chain services rather than only internal operations.
